title: UDTHR
description: TPA, RTP and home made simple.
body:
# UDTRH

UDTRH is a Minecraft Java plugin for **1.21+ / 1.21.2+** servers. It provides:

- `/home` GUI for saved homes
- `/sethome [name]` and `/delhome [name]`
- `/tpa` GUI and `/tpa <player>` requests
- `/tpaccept` and `/tpdeny` request GUI/actions
- `/rtp` GUI for random teleport
- 3 second teleport warmup
- Combat blocking for home, TPA, and RTP teleports
- Per-player files in `plugins/UDTRH/playerdata`
- Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Folia support

## Install

Put `UDTRH.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder and restart the server.

## Notes

- The plugin compiles against Spigot API `1.21-R0.1-SNAPSHOT` for broad compatibility.
- Folia support is handled through reflective scheduler calls, so the same jar can still run on classic Bukkit-style servers.
- Player data is saved as YAML files under `plugins/UDTRH/playerdata`.
